newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Forbo sees higher profit, plans provisions.
newsitem.headline: Forbo sees higher profit, plans provisions.

text.p: Swiss floor and wall covering market Forbo Holding AG said it was making provisions this year of between an estimated 25 to 30 million Swiss francs, but nonetheless it expects to report higher full year holding company results.
However, chief executive Rene Ruett told a news conference that while the company expects to maintain its dividend, group net profits will be slightly lower in 1996.
It said the provisions would be for the potential disposal or closure costs in unprofitable business sectors.
"Short-term, our strong market positions continue to encourage a prognosis that operating results and annual profit will exceed last year," Forbo said in its third quarter statement.
Forbo reported 1995 group net income of 55.6 million Swiss francs.
